slots.jd.family-contractor.about:
About us and the job
Hollis and Sons Electric is a family-owned electrical contractor in Dayton, Ohio. We run the business ourselves, know our customers by name and stand behind every job we do. We are looking for an apprentice electrician to work on site alongside our licensed electricians. You will learn the trade by doing the work, with someone experienced checking it before we hand it over.
slots.jd.family-contractor.duties:
What the job involves
- Tracing faults in circuits and equipment and helping find the cause before repairs begin
- Reading plans and drawings to lay out each job before work starts
- Installing panels, breakers and fixtures to the drawings and to code
- Pulling, terminating and labelling wire neatly so the next person can follow it
- Keeping the job site tidy and safe and looking after tools and materials
- Asking questions and having your work checked by a licensed electrician
slots.jd.family-contractor.needs:
What you need
- 2 or more years of experience as an electrical apprentice or helper
- Panel installation and fire alarm wiring on site
- Troubleshooting with confident multimeter use
- Blueprint reading and a working knowledge of grounding and bonding
- A current Construction Safety Card (required)
- A Journeyman Electrician Licence is preferred but not required
slots.r1.b1: Installs panels and fixtures from the drawings, using blueprint reading to plan each layout and cutting rework on finished installs by 40 percent.
slots.r1.b2: Runs conduit through job sites, applying safe power tool use to cut, bend and fasten each run to plan.
slots.r1.b3: Pulls and terminates wire for motor controls circuits, labelling each conductor and reducing termination errors found at inspection by 50 percent.
slots.r1.b4: Traces faults in branch circuits through careful multimeter use, isolating open and shorted conductors before repairs begin.
slots.r1.i1: Works on site at Summit Power Contractors as an apprentice electrician, tracing faults in wiring and equipment under supervision.
slots.r1.i2: Reads plans and drawings at Summit Power Contractors to lay out electrical work before installation begins.
slots.summary.1: Apprentice electrician with about 2 years of experience working under a journeyman who checks every job. Brings troubleshooting, load calculations and code compliance to daily site work.
slots.summary.2: Entry-level electrical worker with about 2 years on the tools, with every job reviewed by a supervising journeyman. Applies troubleshooting, load calculations and code compliance to each task from layout to final check.
